description: Fix all backend bugs, add missing API endpoints, improve error handling, add proper logging, fix Celery task closure issues, add a dedicated logs endpoint, fix rate-limiting logic, add email validation service, and add campaign duplicate/analytics endpoints.
steps: Create a new git branch called 'feat/full-agent-overhaul' from main

Fix backend/app/tasks.py: The lambda inside with_retries creates a closure bug in loops - the contact variable may be stale. Extract to a local function or use functools.partial. Also fix _sent_count_since which accepts campaign_id but never uses it in the query filter.

Add a dedicated GET /api/logs endpoint in backend/app/api/dashboard.py that returns paginated logs (limit/offset query params) across all campaigns with contact email joined. The current logs page only sees 8 entries from the dashboard stats endpoint.

Add POST /api/campaigns/{id}/duplicate endpoint in backend/app/api/campaigns.py that deep-copies a campaign (name, type, prompt_template, tone, length, temperature, delay_seconds) with 'Copy of' prefix and Draft status.

Add GET /api/campaigns/{id}/analytics endpoint in backend/app/api/campaigns.py returning detailed metrics: total_contacts, valid_contacts, emails_generated, emails_approved, emails_sent, emails_failed, delivery_rate, open_rate (placeholder 0), avg_generation_time (placeholder).

Add a new service backend/app/services/email_validator.py with a function validate_email_address(email) that checks format via regex and optionally does DNS MX record lookup (using dnspython). Add dnspython to requirements.txt.
Add POST /api/contacts/{campaign_id}/validate endpoint in backend/app/api/contacts.py that runs email validation on all contacts in the campaign, updating their status to Valid/Invalid.

Add PUT /api/campaigns/{id} endpoint in backend/app/api/campaigns.py for updating campaign settings (name, prompt_template, tone, length, temperature, delay_seconds). Only allowed in Draft/Generated status.
Add GET /api/campaigns/{id}/export endpoint that returns a CSV file of all contacts with their email status (sent/failed/pending) and generated subject lines.

Add a new backend/app/api/templates.py router with CRUD endpoints for reusable email templates: GET /api/templates/, POST /api/templates/, GET /api/templates/{id}, PUT /api/templates/{id}, DELETE /api/templates/{id}. Add an EmailTemplate model to models.py with fields: id, name, description, subject_template, body_template, category, created_at.
Add the EmailTemplate model to backend/app/models.py and corresponding Pydantic schemas to backend/app/schemas.py.
Register the templates router in backend/app/main.py.

Add a new backend/app/services/scheduler.py with a function that stores scheduled send times. Add a 'scheduled_at' optional DateTime column to the Campaign model. Add POST /api/campaigns/{id}/schedule endpoint.
Improve backend/app/services/email_sender.py: add HTML email support (set_content with subtype='html'), add a sender_name parameter for the From header display name.
Add proper Python logging throughout backend: configure logging in main.py, add logger usage in tasks.py, ai_generator.py, email_sender.py instead of silent failures.
Update backend/requirements.txt to include dnspython and any other new dependencies.
Ensure all new endpoints have proper error handling with HTTPException and meaningful error messages.
acceptance_criteria: Backend starts without errors: uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 runs successfully
All new endpoints are accessible and return proper responses (checked via /docs)
The closure bug in tasks.py is fixed - each contact's email generation uses the correct contact_data
The logs endpoint supports pagination with limit and offset parameters
Campaign duplicate creates a new campaign with all settings copied
Email validation service properly validates email format
CSV export returns proper CSV content with content-disposition header
Campaign update endpoint validates status before allowing changes
verification: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python -c "from app.main import app; print('Backend imports OK')"
cd backend && python -c "from app.models import EmailTemplate, Campaign; print('Models OK')"
cd backend && python -c "from app.services.email_validator import validate_email_address; print('Validator OK')"
cd backend && python -c "from app.api.templates import router; print('Templates router OK')"
